summary: Map kit: smaller stairs and no overlapping map objects
author: client
body:
Goal (user, 2026-11-24): "Make the stairs smaller and try not to allow overlap of map objects".

Done-when: stairs about two thirds of current height; icons placed with gap-based nudging instead of drop-when-covered; zero intersecting icon rects (clusters excepted); kit rebuilt, ink unchanged; previews checked.

**Verified, 2026-11-24:** the read-only review passed after the fixes (leaders are skipped when their point is covered by a placed icon; leader ink is written straight to the kit; dropped icons are named). The reviewer's own JSON check over 293 icons found 0 overlaps, 0 margin or bounds violations and 0 missing frames. 17 icons were nudged, 0 dropped, 0 leaders, and no ink.png changed. The kit was deployed and the Map item opened in game on `default`. The smaller stairs were checked only in previews, not in game. Committed as d95843b.
